name: local-copilot
description: A VS Code chat sidebar powered by local Ollama models.

localCopilot.ollamaBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the local Ollama HTTP API.

localCopilot.defaultModel.description: Chat model selected when the chat view opens.

localCopilot.codeModel.description: Larger coding model used by /code. It must support Ollama tool calling.

localCopilot.autoDelegate.description: Let the chat model decide on its own to hand coding tasks to the code model. Requires a chat model with tool-calling support; /code always works.

localCopilot.reviewChanges.description: Show a diff and ask for approval before the code model writes a file. Deleting a file always asks.

localCopilot.requestTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for an Ollama request.

scripts.test: npm run compile && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test "out-test/test/*.test.js"
